question: Does any exact boundary obtained by freeing every edge incident to the six vertices in the core-kick candidate's two-conflict union and any pair of additional vertices contain a Ramsey(5,5;43) graph?

scope.extra_vertex_rule: each two-element subset of the 37 vertices outside the conflict union, in lexicographic order
scope.free_edge_rule: every edge having at least one endpoint in the eight selected incident vertices
scope.fixed_edge_rule: every other edge equals the base graph

outcome_policy.SAT: Reconstruct the full graph, require direct zero-forbidden-set enumeration in the worker, then run both repository verifiers and the adversarial artifact audit before making a lower-bound claim.
outcome_policy.UNSAT: Record only a non-proof-carrying negative observation for that exact fixed boundary.
outcome_policy.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Record an unresolved boundary; it is neither SAT nor UNSAT.
outcome_policy.all_negative: This does not imply global nonexistence and does not change any Ramsey-number bound.
